what_this_is: Canonical names corrected from the property's OWN page, for census identities whose discovered name is a bare chain word. The census is not edited: it remains the record of what discovery OBSERVED, and this overlay is what a reader should be shown instead. Every row cites the page that states the replacement, so a correction can be checked or withdrawn by deleting one entry.
authorised_by: PTF-PITTSBURGH-FOUNDER-EXCEPTION-RULINGS-002 section 2A (APPROVE_WITH_CHANGE, canonical_name), ruled by PTF-FOUNDER-001 on 2026-08-26
rule: A replacement may only be a name the property's own captured page states. Nothing here is invented, and no correction adds or alters a policy fact.
